newsitem.title: CHINA: China Stone Group in 'smart card' project.
newsitem.headline: China Stone Group in 'smart card' project.

text.p: China's Stone Group Corp has said an affiliate would sign a $4 million accord this week with the German company Orga to produce "smart cards" for the postal savings system.
Stone was also talking with AT&T Corp's NCR Corp unit for a possible $26 million joint venture to produce automated teller machines, Stone president Duan Yongji told Reuters.
Orga, a maker of bank cards, would hold 55 percent of the smart card venture while various Chinese companies would have a combined 45 percent, Duan said in an interview late on Tuesday.

The Stone Group's joint venture with companies under the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications would hold the bulk of the Chinese stake in the project. The Stone Group controls Hong Kong-listed Stone Electronic Technology Ltd.
The venture, based in the southern China city of Shenzhen, would produce bank savings cards with an integrated circuit chip. Work on the project would begin early next year, Duan said.
